name: Discordia & Sun promo

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after the 4th year (incl. both end-of-year events), or immediately when a player has no workers left in reserve

categories.label: Workers left in your reserve
categories.hint: Fewest wins. 0 at any time during the game = immediate win. At year 4 end, workers on City Tiles/Towers are not counted.

categories.label: Workers placed on City Tiles/Towers
categories.labelVi: Worker đang đặt trên City Tile/Tháp

tiebreakers.description: Fewest Workers placed on City Tiles/Towers wins.

winCondition: No victory points. Win at once by having no Workers in your reserve at any time; otherwise the player with the fewest Workers in reserve after the 4th year and its two end-of-year events wins.
notes: family: race-objective. Sun promo (5 wooden discs placed on bonus spaces below the Seasons Boat) only adds variance to bonus spaces and does not change end scoring. Solo: win by having no workers in reserve by the end of year 4. workersOnTiles is tiebreaker only and has countsToTotal=false. Expansions (Magna etc.) not modelled.
